newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 7:
EREZ CHECKPOINT - Israeli and Palestinian leaders reopened long-stalled peace talks, with the United States backing Israeli demands for new security measures in light of recent bloody rioting.
WASHINGTON - Across the country, more neighbourhoods are challenging the rights of religious institutions to expand or build, and more often, the neighbours are prevailing.
WASHINGTON - Federal sentencing guidelines have shifted much of the power of the courtroom from judges to prosecutors and law enforcement.

WASHINGTON - Roberto Alomar, who spat in the face of an umpire a week-and-a-half ago, has become the most immediately compelling figure in u.s. sports after a home run in Saturday's game between the Baltimore Orioles and the Cleveland Indians.

NEW YORK - New York Mayor Rudolph Giuliani has become the newest and most sought after spokesman for American immigrants' rights, a fact that is somewhat surprising since his Republican party supports significant restrictions on immigration.
